title: OmniVoice Custom Nodes for ComfyUI
summary: A ComfyUI integration for the OmniVoice zero-shot voice cloning model, enabling high-quality text-to-speech and voice design within node-based workflows. It supports over 600 languages and achieves real-time factors as low as 0.025.
research_notes: Requires PyTorch 2.8.0 or later; users are advised to install via ComfyUI Manager or use the --no-deps flag to avoid dependency conflicts with the core ComfyUI environment.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from early community ports to the stabilized Saganaki22 implementation, which introduced SageAttention support, memory optimizations for Windows, and advanced dialogue tagging for non-verbal expressions.
